headline: 14 killed in bus-truck collision in Natore
summary: Five traders from Shariatpur were among the victims of a head-on crash on the Pabna-Natore highway near Bonpara.
details: A head-on collision between a bus and a sand-laden truck on the Pabna-Natore highway near Bonpara in Natore killed 14 people and left at least 30 others injured.
Among the deceased were five traders from Kazirhat Bazar in Shariatpur's Zajira upazila, who were traveling to Rajshahi to purchase agricultural produce and seeds for the Rabi season.
The deceased traders have been identified as Jewel Madbar (40), Salal Mollya (46), Sohag Shikdar (30), Samad Fakir (70), and Shahin Bepari (32).

The accident occurred around 4:10 am today after the traders had traveled from the Naodoba roundabout near the Padma Bridge South Plaza to Bhanga bus stand in Faridpur before boarding a bus for Rajshahi.
According to Prothom Alo, the bus was being driven by a supervisor, while the actual driver was sleeping in the back seat.
Local administration and the Kazirhat Banik Samity are coordinating to bring the bodies of the Shariatpur traders back to their hometown for a joint funeral prayer.
Zajira Upazila Nirbahi Officer Md Al Imran stated that the administration will provide all necessary assistance to the families of the deceased.

headline: 1,366 hospitalized in a day as 5 more die of dengue
summary: The total death toll has risen to 357, with over 1.15 lakh cases reported so far this year, according to the DGHS.
details: At least five dengue patients died and 1,366 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
Of the deaths, two each were reported in Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) and Barishal division, while one was reported in Rangpur division.
With the latest deaths and cases, the total death toll rose to 357 and the number of cases to 1,15,617.
Currently, 5,944 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
